name: Recall Drag to Canvas
description: Drag any part of any web page onto a Recall Canvas: a paragraph, a table, a code block, a figure, a card. It lands as Blocks, or hold Shift to drop it as a picture.

action.default_title: Recall Drag to Canvas: hold Alt over any part of a page, then drag its ⠿ onto the Canvas

toggle-grips.description: Show the ⠿ grips on this tab without holding Alt (press again to stop)
